audit_method: source jar is retained for provenance; named transformed bytecode is used for automatic call-site and representative-shape checks

conclusion.body_material_callbacks: only cells inside the body box contracted by 1e-7
conclusion.collision_shape_owners: broad shape candidates may include one lower owner
conclusion.fluid_boundary: fluid and block-collision callbacks use body cells; a lower broad owner hidden behind the cover is not a body-contact cell
conclusion.full_cube_shadow: a lower local x/z-bounded shape with local max_y<=2 adds no collision outside the known full cube directly above
conclusion.moving_piston_boundary: a legal upward piston move first plans and replaces its destination, so a moving lower owner cannot coexist with the unchanged full-cube destination; horizontal/downward push and honey boxes remain below the cover top. A later piston tick is a world-change/external-force event, not frozen-shape evidence
conclusion.synthetic_unsupported_boundary: unsupported BlockGeometry fixtures only lock query/cache semantics and are not claimed as additional vanilla states
